name: recoil_state_save_load_transition_on_deactivate
description: RecoilStateSaveLoadTransition::OnDeactivate tears down the active save/load dialog and, when presentation capture was enabled, unloads DIALOG sounds, restores paused audio voices, unmutes active voices, restores half-res/invalidate state, and reactivates the current HUD layout.
known_limits: tier S remains pending for the broader save/load transition source cluster.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x435ed0 validates the m_dialog gate, postprocess, virtual SetEnabled(0), HudUiDialogController::BlitOwnedSurfaceToPrimary, unlock, virtual scalar deleting destructor with flags 1, dialog clear, disabled presentation early return, DIALOG sample-set destroy, optional zSndPlayHandleSnapshot::RestoreAllWithGlobalVolumeDelta, zSnd::ApplyMuteStateToActiveVoices(0), saved half-res/invalidate restore, and HudUiMgr::TriggerCurrentLayoutOnActivated.

Native smoke recoil_state_save_load_transition_on_deactivate_smoke patches the presentation blit path, verifies disabled capture only tears down and clears the dialog, and verifies enabled capture unloads DIALOG resources, restores half-res/invalidate state, and triggers the current layout.
